published_estimand: Annual child-directed bequest flow divided by aggregate net worth, following the unchanged Gale-Scholz / De Nardi-Yang definition.

verified_candidate.scenario: head-death household-wealth proxy; legal marriage only for the 25% child share; 75% otherwise; estate base max(NETWORTH - TRUSTS, 0); qx95 mapping for public SCF ages top-coded at 95; denominator aggregate signed NETWORTH

comparison.preferred_method_matching_candidate: The 0.7291% trust-excluded estate-base row matches the published exclusion of estimated trusts more closely than the 0.7514% trust-inclusive numerator row.
comparison.historical_reference: Gale-Scholz 1986 value is $105bn / $11,976bn = 0.8765%, reported as 0.88%; it is historical and was not reused as the 2007 estimate.

input_validation.weights: WGT = X42001/5 checked row-by-row; five-implicate pooling retained.

limitations_not_pending_work: GS documents 25% for a married head death and 75% for a single head or same-year death of both spouses, but does not specify whether whole-household wealth is attributed at one spouse death or only joint death, or how marital estate ownership is split. This candidate explicitly uses head death times whole PEU wealth.

GS child-directed shares require child eligibility; the available SCF KIDS variable counts current rostered children and cannot establish lifetime offspring. The candidate applies the shares mechanically to the SCF PEUs.
SCF public ages are top-coded at 95; qx95 is the reported candidate and qx99/qx100+ are disclosed sensitivity scenarios, not uncertainty intervals.
adoption: Author adopted ratio 0.007291023472616158 (0.7291023472616158 percent) as the next-calibration annual child-directed bequest-flow / aggregate-wealth target. This is not an exact historical replication and does not alter frozen contracts.
deferred_refinement: Revisit the household-wealth allocation at one spouse death versus joint death, and child-recipient eligibility/share assumptions. The adopted target remains active pending that refinement.
completion: The available-data computation and source comparison are complete. No further recalculation is pending; only the explicitly deferred methodological refinement remains.
